commands.check: Check the structured data of the active view

jsonld.context: The type {type} has no schema.org context: add "@context": "https://schema.org".

property.domain: {type}: the property {property} is not meant for this type.
property.range: The value "{value}" of {property} is not of an expected kind: {expected}.

rich.required_any: {type}: the rich result needs one of {properties}.

panel.cut: The answer was shortened; MCP structureddata_inspect gives all of it.
panel.empty: The page has no structured data.
panel.findingsAt: {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} at this node
panel.noBlocks: The page has no JSON-LD block.
panel.noFindings: No findings: the structured data meets every rule.
panel.rawCut: The block is longer than shown here.
panel.rawDropped: The raw text was left out of the shortened answer.
panel.reported: {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} sent to the findings panel.
panel.richOff: Rich results are not checked (Settings › Checks › Structured data).
panel.showRef: Show the node it points to
panel.summary: {error, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warning, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}, {info, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}
panel.truncated: The page has more nodes than are read; the last ones are left out.

jsonld.context: A JSON-LD node without the schema.org context
jsonld.invalid: A JSON-LD block is no JSON

property.domain: A property not meant for its type
property.range: A value of a kind the property does not expect
property.unknown: A property schema.org does not have

rich.recommended: A property the rich result recommends is missing
rich.required: A property the rich result needs is missing
rich.required_any: None of the properties the rich result needs one of

type.unknown: A type schema.org does not have

minSeverity.description: The mildest findings shown and reported: notes, warnings or errors only.
minSeverity.help: Findings milder than this are neither shown in the panel nor sent to the findings panel. Example: Warnings hides the notes on superseded properties.
minSeverity.label: Mildest finding shown

richResults.description: Check the properties the rich results of Google Search need and recommend.
richResults.help: Holds Product, Article, BreadcrumbList, Organization, FAQ and their parts to the properties a rich result of Google Search needs (an error when missing) and recommends (a warning). When off, it checks the schema.org vocabulary only.
richResults.label: Check rich results

tools.inspect: The schema.org data of the page the target view shows (JSON-LD, Microdata, RDFa) as a tree, the raw JSON-LD blocks and the findings against the schema.org vocabulary and the rich-result needs, each at its node.
